import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

payload = json.loads(r'''{"feature_match_output_file": "/home/icsl/sothoth/13-secflow-service/image_build/secflow-app-firmware-unpacker/unpacked-demo2-skill-rerun-unified/S6730_V200R024C00SPC500.cc/run/feature-match.json", "output_path": "/home/icsl/sothoth/13-secflow-service/image_build/secflow-app-firmware-unpacker/unpacked-demo2-skill-rerun-unified/S6730_V200R024C00SPC500.cc/output", "skill_author_output_file": "/home/icsl/sothoth/13-secflow-service/image_build/secflow-app-firmware-unpacker/unpacked-demo2-skill-rerun-unified/S6730_V200R024C00SPC500.cc/run/generated_skill.md"}''')
review = r'''AGENTFLOW_REVIEW_SKIPPED reason=SKIPPED_BY_SKILL_SUCCESS'''
if 'AGENTFLOW_REVIEW_SUCCESS' not in review:
    print('SKIPPED_NO_GENERIC_SUCCESS')
else:
    feature_payload = json.loads(Path(payload['feature_match_output_file']).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    features = feature_payload.get('features') or {}
    family_id = str(features.get('family_id') or 'generic-firmware')
    slug = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', family_id.lower()).strip('-') or 'generic-firmware'
    ext = str(features.get('ext') or features.get('ext2') or '').strip()
    if not ext:
        ext = '.bin'
    magic_hex = str(features.get('magic_hex') or '').strip()
    sigs = ', '.join(str(item) for item in features.get('binwalk_sigs') or [])
    if not sigs:
        sigs = 'firmware'
    summary = Path(payload['output_path']) / 'summary.txt'
    summary_text = summary.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') if summary.is_file() else ''
    doc = f'''---
name: {slug} unpack
description: Candidate firmware unpacking guidance generated from a successful AgentFlow run
format_id: {slug}
extensions: {ext}
magic_hex: {magic_hex}
keywords: firmware, unpack, {slug}
binwalk_sigs: {sigs}
skill_status: candidate
skill_version: 1
family_id: {family_id}
promotion_success_count: 0
promotion_threshold: 5
tools: file, binwalk, dd, readelf, strings
---

Use this skill for firmware images with the same recognition signals. Re-run binwalk, extract the embedded component at the detected offset, preserve the original header when present, and write summary.txt with extracted artifacts and reuse notes.

Source summary:
{summary_text}
'''
    Path(payload['skill_author_output_file']).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    Path(payload['skill_author_output_file']).write_text(doc, encoding='utf-8')
    print(f"AGENTFLOW_SKILL_AUTHOR_WRITTEN path={payload['skill_author_output_file']}")
